register_sales_tax.title: Register for Ohio Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: FBA inventory or $100k/$200 txn (OR test, includes marketplace) creates nexus. Register as a vendor with OH DOR.

steps.title: Register via Ohio Business Gateway
steps.detail: Apply for a vendor's license through the Ohio Business Gateway online portal.

steps.title: Note filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Ohio assigns semi-monthly, monthly, or quarterly filing. Returns due the 23rd of the month following the period.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable OH tax in Shopify. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Update Registrations page.

franchise_or_entity.title: Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT)
franchise_or_entity.summary: Ohio CAT is a gross receipts tax at 0.26% on receipts over $1M. Minimum $150 annual tax for businesses with $150k-$1M in OH gross receipts. FBA inventory may create CAT nexus.

steps.title: Determine if CAT applies
steps.detail: If your Ohio gross receipts exceed $150,000, the CAT minimum tax ($150) applies. If over $1M, the 0.26% rate applies. CAT has its own nexus provisions (bright-line test: $500k receipts or $50k payroll/property in OH).
common_pitfalls: CAT is separate from sales tax.
Interaction between FBA inventory and CAT nexus is not fully settled — confirm with CPA.

steps.title: Register for CAT if applicable
steps.detail: Register via Ohio Business Gateway. Annual minimum tax ($150) due May 10. Quarterly estimated payments if annual CAT exceeds $1,500.
steps.deadline_rule: Annual minimum due May 10; quarterly estimates if > $1,500
